page.overview:
What is Head Boy?

A Head Boy or Head Girl was a seventh-year student who had authority over prefects at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Each year, both a Head Boy and a Head Girl were selected by the Headmaster or Headmistress of Hogwarts. The pair of students were instructed to perform duties to assist the school. They led both the prefects and (in many cases) the entire student body.

At the beginning of the school year, the Headmaster or Headmistress appointed one Head Boy and one Head Girl from all of the seventh-year students. These students were chosen because of their academic achievement, outstanding reputation as a student, and a honest, good, and hard-working personality.

Prefects may have had a greater chance of being appointed to this position, as both had similar expectations on the student; however, this was not a prerequisite.

The names of every Head Boy and Girl were recorded on a scroll in the Trophy Room.
